project_info.title: Unruffled retro traveler and curious shark

prompt.main_subject: An adult woman in a 1970s American retro summer outfit with sunglasses and a mustard headscarf, calmly drinking coffee in a cream canoe.
prompt.composition_elements: Symmetrical vertical 9:16 art-film tableau with a cream canoe, coffee cup, paddle, turquoise sea, and a distant curious shark fin.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Bright sun softened by sea haze, yellow-green nostalgic grade, saturated colors, 35mm texture, and slight cinematic grain.

technical_specs.motion: Small shark splash followed by a harmless paddle tap and retreat.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: An adult woman in a 1970s American retro summer outfit sits calmly in a cream canoe on a gently turbulent sea, drinking coffee while wearing sunglasses and a mustard headscarf. A curious shark fin briefly surfaces nearby, creating a small splash. She remains elegant and unruffled, picks up the paddle, taps the water once to send a harmless spray away from the canoe, and the shark glides back into the sea. No subtitles or dialogue. Use symmetrical retro art-film styling, yellow-green tone, saturated nostalgic colors, 35mm film texture, and slight cinematic grain.
prompt.negative_prompt: gore, blood, animal injury, explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, minor, watermark, garbled text, distorted anatomy, extra limbs, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, extra fingers, deformed
